rows.label: qst650501_0040
rows.name: The flower of the country he loved...

rows.label: qst650501_0050
rows.name: They even prepared data like this...

rows.label: qst650501_0060
rows.name:
And such a vast battlefield... It's
hard to believe this is a simulation...

rows.label: qst650501_0080
rows.name:
He prepared quite an interesting
battle simulator for me.

rows.label: qst650501_0100
rows.name: I see. So those are the enemies.

rows.label: qst650501_0110
rows.name:
Only that many...? I'll have to tell
him the difficulty was set too low.

rows.label: qst650501_0120
rows.name:
The first strike wins. I'll
ambush them with ranged Arts...

rows.label: qst650501_0140
rows.name:
That did good damage. I'll keep
the rhythm going at close range!

rows.label: qst650501_0170
rows.name: That voice... It doesn't match the Bias data...

rows.label: qst650501_0180
rows.name:
Even if the simulator is bugged,
it's best to clear this quickly.
